# GraphForge extension ledger (vendored)

`RESULT_SCHEMAS.md` is copied verbatim from CurateLabs/graphforge-vscode
`docs/engineering/RESULT_SCHEMAS.md` at commit `e51c83e` (branch
`issue-80-typed-canonical-projection`, Apache-2.0). A Rust test
(`graphforge::ledger` in `crates/xyg-engine`) fails when XYG's coverage ledger
disagrees with it on schema ids, dispositions, or algorithm membership.
Refresh the copy whenever the extension changes its ledger.
